snippet.title: Clayface | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet the new face of Gotham. #ClayfaceMovie only in theaters October 23.

DC Studios’ “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery.

Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

The film also stars Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan, as well as Nancy Carroll and Joshua James.

James Watkins directs from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, story by Flanagan, based on characters from DC. The film is produced by Matt Reeves, Lynn Harris, James Gunn and Peter Safran, with Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Rafi Crohn and Paul Ritchie executive producing.

Watkins’ creative team includes director of photography Rob Hardy, production designer James Price, editor Jon Harris and costume designer Keith Madden. Music is by Volker Bertelmann.

DC Studios Presents a 6th & Idaho Production, a James Watkins Film, “Clayface.” The film will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures and released only in theaters in North America on October 23, 2026, and internationally beginning 21 October 2026.

snippet.title: Lanterns, Resident Evil, Marvel's Wolverine, & Ebenezer SDCC TRAILER REACTIONS!!
snippet.description:
LANTERNS, MARVEL’S WOLVERINE, RESIDENT EVIL, & EBENEZER TRAILER REACTIONS!!!  With SDCC 2026 Fully underway, we’ve got a fresh crop of San Diego Comic Con Trailers to React to!!

● Build credit fast and get your first month for just a dollar at https://www.getkikoff.com/rejects today. Thanks to Kikoff for sponsoring us!

First up DC’s new Lanterns trailer gives us a deeper look at both the criminal and cosmic stakes as Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler - Friday Night Lights, Godzilla Kong of the Monsters) attempts to train future lantern Jon Stewart (Aaron Pierre - Rebel Ridge, Mufasa: The Lion King) as an even greater threat - the Manhunters - looms its ugly head…  from show runners Damon Lindeloff (Watchmen), Chris Mundy (Ozark), and Tom King (Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow) the cast also includes Nathan Fillion (Superman, Firefly) as Guy Gardner, along with Laura Linney (Ozark), Kelly Macdonald (No Country for Old Men), Garret Dillahunt (Deadwood), and MORE!  

Next we turn our eyes toward Marvel reacting to the Wolverine Story Trailer revealed at SDCC 2026! Marvel’s Wolverine PS5 trailer gives us a deeper look at Logan’s past, his connection to Jean Grey and Team X, and his violent battles against Lady Deathstrike, Omega Red, The Hand, the Reavers and Bolivar Trask’s Sentinels.  We discuss the Weapon X imagery, Wolverine’s adamantium skeleton, the darker and more graphic combat, and the game’s mix of emotional storytelling, horror and brutal action. They also react to Jean Grey attempting to reach Logan, Lady Deathstrike preparing for battle, Omega Red’s appearance and the possibility of Wolverine rejoining Team X.

After that, Greg & John Give their reaction to Zach Cregger’s full Resident Evil Official Trailer - bringing the survival horror of Raccoon City back to the big screen with Austin Abrams (Euphoria, Whalefall).  They break down Austin Abrams’ journey toward Raccoon City General, the abandoned farmhouse, the ominous phone call, the search for shotgun shells, the typewriter save reference, and the game-inspired use of fixed camera angles and over-the-shoulder shots.

Que lo nuestro no es debido

Y diferencia en las edades
Estos tontos ignorantes
No me quieren ver contigo

Pa' que dos se quieran

Que se mueran los incrédulos envidiosos
Si nos tronchan el destino
No lo duden una lengua venenosa
Es más mortal que un cuchillo
Que caigan todos en abismo
Si es que no aceptan nuestro idilio

Qué demonio importa
El estatus económico
Si el alma no tiene valor

Son numeritos que fastidio

But just remember one thing
The King Stays King
¿Y le gusta mi bachata, amiguita?

Nuestro amor, no es fugaz
Ni pasatiempo
Es valiente muy estable
Sin complejos
Y así nos critican a los dos
Total en fin
Que los perdone Dios

Si no me quieren ver contigo

[Outro]
You need this in your life
Keep talkin'

snippet.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition – Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
The digital version of the Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game will be available on July 30. The physical version launches on October 1. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://ninten.do/6002vAKxo

Join Rex and Pyra in their search for paradise, now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system! The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game features improved visuals, smoother and sharper cutscenes, new outfit designs for Pyra and Mythra, and more. Control up to six Blades directly in the new Merc Assault mode, and discover MOMO—a new rare Blade who can swap between light and dark forms.

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Xenoblade Chronicles 2 on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by purchasing the upgrade pack.

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

snippet.title: LANTERNS Official Trailer REACTION & Breakdown - Manhunters, Sinestro & MORE!!
snippet.description:
LANTERNS Official Trailer REACTION & Breakdown - Manhunters, Sinestro & MORE!! - We cover the news on James Gunn's DC Universe with the new DCU Lanterns official trailer! We breakdown the new Lanterns official trailer which shows a lot more Green Lantern footage! We get new looks at Hal Jordan and John Stewart, and major new teasers of Manhuntners as a villain in the series. We also get new looks at Hal Jordan's Green Lantern suit as meets with Ulrich Thomsen's Sinestro and plenty of new looks at Green Lantern constructs as Hal Jordan defends against an alien attack. We also discuss Guy Gardner, and Laura Linney's casting as a Guardian of the universe! Lanterns involves a dark mystery that explores two timelines in the DCU that lead up to the events of Superman. Will this new Lanterns teaser trailer win DC fans over? Is there enough Green Lantern mythology included? We cover all the big details revealed including new plot details and more DCU connections. Also discussing theories surrounding Sinestro, Atrocitus, Blackest Night and Black Hand and how Lanterns could tie into the main story of the DCU and much more from DCU Gods and Monsters, Lanterns, Justice League, The Batman 2 and other DCU News, DCU Leaks and more!

The 2026 LCS Summer Split kicks off tomorrow, and we're celebrating with throwback rivalry showmatch between legends from TSM and CLG rosters past, taking to the rift on League Classic!

The LCS Summer Split features a best-of-three round-robin regular season, ensuring more games, deeper rivalries, and a clear competitive arc from Week 1 to Finals. At the end of the regular season, the top six teams advance to a double-elimination playoff bracket. Every series matters, and every adjustment counts. The stakes are high, as the top two teams qualify for the 2026 League of Legends World Championship, hosted here in in North America, to represent the LCS against the world’s best.

In 2026, the LCS Fantasy app (https://lcsofficial.gg/en) becomes a comprehensive hub for fans. Schedules, standings, content, and fantasy integration all live in one place, making it easier than ever to follow the league and compete with your friends. We’re building this as a true home for LCS fans everywhere, whether you’re tuning in every weekend or tracking every stat between matches. Let us know what you think!

Catch the LCS every Saturday and Sunday (and some Fridays!):

Games begin at 1PM PT / 3PM CT / 4PM ET

League of Legends Championship Series teams include Cloud9 Kia, FlyQuest, Team Liquid Alienware, Dignitas, Shopify Rebellion, LYON, Sentinels, and Disguised.

You can always learn more and view the full match schedule at https://lolesports.com/en-US?leagues=...

snippet.title: Al Final del Día - XOLO Music (Video Lyric)
snippet.description:
"Al Final del Día", el lanzamiento de XOLO Music. Un tema de regional mexicano que habla sobre aceptar el final de una relación sin buscar culpables, recordando lo bonito y reconociendo los errores.

Si en tu playlist no pueden faltar éxitos de Grupo Firme, Christian Nodal, Carín León o Fuerza Regida, esta canción tiene que estar en tu rotación. Una atmósfera melancólica perfecta para quienes disfrutan de himnos de desamor como "Ya Supérame", "Botella Tras Botella" o "Que Vuelvas", con un estilo vocal inspirado en la fuerza de Eduin Caz, la banda sinaloense y el sierreño.

⚠️ Disclaimer de Producción: La composición y producción de esta pista fueron creadas utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA), fusionando la creatividad conceptual con la tecnología generativa para explorar el futuro del regional mexicano.

🔔 Suscríbete al canal para más música: [Inserta Link de suscripción directa]

LETRA OFICIAL:
Se nos acabó el camino,
se nos fue secando el río,
y aunque le echamos mil ganas,
no duró nuestro cariño.
No hay culpables en la historia,
no te apunto con el dedo,
simplemente no jaló,
y aceptarlo es lo que puedo.
Al final del día,
te juro, no me arrepiento de nada.
Cada risa, cada beso,
cada pinche madrugada,
valieron toda la pena,
cada segundo contigo,
y eso me lo llevo conmigo.
Y solo espero que algún día,
cuando te llegue el recuerdo,
cuando pienses en nosotros,
no me guardes ni un "te quiero".
Solo espero y sonrías,
y te digas en voz baja:
"Ese pinche vato loco y amargado,
la neta sí me amaba".
Que te acuerdes de lo bueno
y que el tiempo borre el daño,
porque al final, mi reina,
te quise.
Y no sabes cuánto.
Yo sé que no fui perfecto,
con mi genio y mi locura,
pero te amé a mi manera,
con toda mi alma impura.
Y aunque ya no estés conmigo
y otro sane tu quebranto,
siempre serás la mujer
a la que quise tanto...
Y solo espero que algún día,
cuando te llegue el recuerdo,
cuando pienses en nosotros,
no me guardes ni un "te quiero".
Solo espero y sonrías,
y te digas en voz baja:
"Ese pinche vato loco y amargado,
la neta sí me amaba".
Que te acuerdes de lo bueno
y que el tiempo borre el daño,
porque al final, mi reina,
te quise.
Y no sabes cuánto...
(Este pinche vato loco...
pero te amo. ¡Ánimo!)

snippet.title: Lizzy McAlpine - The light in the painting (Official Video)
snippet.description:
The new album ‘Angel' is out September 18th. Pre-order and pre-save here: https://lizzymcalpine.lnk.to/angel 
Listen to “The light in the painting” now: https://lizzymcalpine.lnk.to/thelightinthepainting

Written by: Lizzy McAlpine
Produced by: Lizzy McAlpine, Mason Stoops, Taylor Mackall

Follow Lizzy: 
https://www.instagram.com/lizzymcalpine/ 
https://www.tiktok.com/@lizzymcalpine  
https://www.twitter.com/lizzymcalpine/ 
https://www.facebook.com/lizzymcalpinemusic/   
https://youtube.com/lizzymcalpine  

Lyrics: 
You are the light in the painting, painting
You are the light in the painting
That my eye is drawn to first

Holy ground when you kiss me
Sacred spaces all around
Steal an hour in the evening
Just to hold you now
Just to hold you now

Meet me where I’ve always been
Feel the lightning on my skin
Time moves slower in a time like this
I stand there blinded by it

You are the light in the painting, painting
You are the light in the painting
That my eye is drawn to first

Hold my breath when you’re near me
Sink my nails into your skin
What a beautiful way
To finally feel something

Start a fire when you touch me
Hold it close between our chests
If somewhere there is a heaven
This is as close as I will get
As close as I will get

snippet.title: Fuerza Regida, Manuel Turizo - UNA CERVEZA (Letra/Lyrics) | "¿qué estás haciendo?"
snippet.description:
👤 Artista | Fuerza Regida, Manuel Turizo
💿 Canción | UNA CERVEZA
📅 Fecha de Lanzamiento | 19/10/2023
🔊 Géneros Musicales | Regional Mexicano

✨ Acerca de la Canción:
"UNA CERVEZA" de Fuerza Regida y Manuel Turizo es una canción que retrata el vacío que deja una ruptura cuando el amor sigue presente. A través de una mezcla de regional mexicano y sonidos urbanos, los artistas expresan la dificultad de olvidar a alguien que marcó profundamente su vida, recordando los momentos compartidos y los planes que nunca llegaron a cumplirse.

📲 Sígue a "Fuerza Regida" en:
▶️ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFLI6KAjrKRtydD7KqiYvAw

⭐ Encuéntrame en Redes:
🔗 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jostland_/
🌐 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/josstland/
🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@iamjostland
📬 Contacto Directo por Instagram: @jostland_

🎶 [ Letra / Lyrics ] 🎶

[Intro: Fuerza Regida, Manuel Turizo & Ambos]
Ey, baby, I miss you
A ver cuándo te vuelvo a ver, mija
Te extraño
Fuerza Regida
Manuel Turizo

[Verso 1: Fuerza Regida & Manuel Turizo]
Una cerveza puede ayudar a que salgas de mi cabeza
No te gustaba el dinero y fue la simpleza
De tus ojitos dormilones al mirar
Cómo te extraño, agarrarte la piernita e ir manejando
En el camino nos estábamos besando
Siempre algo mágico tenía que pasar

[Coro: Fuerza Regida]
Y ahora mi rutina completamente cambió
Ya no me divierten los amigos y еl alcohol
Estoy manejando y la neta ya no sé pa' dónde voy
Ahora mе declaro que soy un antisocial
Siempre había ganado y contigo me fue muy mal
Ya no quiero ser el hombre de antes, la verdad que en realidad
Porque sería fatal

[Verso 2: Manuel Turizo]
Ahora estoy solo, pero con tu recuerdo yo me casé
Canciones tristes, todas me las sé
Coronar sin ti es como que fracasé, ey-ey
Ahora despierto todas las mañanas queriendo tomarme tus ojos café
Duele pero tengo fe
Te necesito a ti, no necesito un médico
Mis pedas, to'as te las dedico
Lo mejor que yo he tenido no lo compró mi tarjeta de crédito
Ayer soñé que volvías, qué bonita te veías
Te abracé mientras callabas, te besé mientras reías

[Verso 3: Fuerza Regida]
Tengo en mi cama una morrita que ni sé cómo se lla—
Se me hace injusto que ella sea la que la paga
Que de tu cuerpo yo no me pueda olvidar
¿Qué estás haciendo?
¿Por qué no regresas a mis brazos corriendo?
¿Dónde quedó lo que dijimos hace tiempo?
Planes de casa, niños y un perro comprar

[Coro: Manuel Turizo, Fuerza Regida & Ambos]
Y ahora mi rutina completamente cambió
Ya no me divierten los amigos ni el alcohol
Estoy manejando y la plena es que no sé pa' dónde voy
Y ahora me declaro que soy un antisocial
Siempre había ganado y contigo me fue muy mal
Ya no quiero ser el hombre de antes, la verdad que en realidad
Porque sería fatal

[Outro: Fuerza Regida & Manuel Turizo]
Baby girl, come back
Manuel Turizo
TQM
Ni un mensaje, ni una llamada
Aquí te hice esta, pa' que la escuches

#FuerzaRegida #ManuelTurizo #UNACERVEZA

snippet.title: When Harriers Ate Skyhawks
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0241

June 8, 1982. It’s the final weeks of the Falklands War. At noon, the Argentinian Air Force (Fuerza Aérea Argentina) catches advancing British forces by surprise, striking two troop ships and setting them ablaze. Three hours later, a wave of Argentinian A4 Skyhawk attack aircraft crosses the islands to strike again. This time there will be no surprise, but orders are orders. The pilots press on, searching for British troops being moved by sea towards the last bastion of Argentinian defence on the islands. Waiting to intercept them are two British Sea Harriers, and a fierce aerial battle begins.

There could have been even fewer survivors that day, but technical failures, combat damage, and a bit of luck meant that three aircraft made it home. To make this film, we used the accounts of all three surviving pilots who took part in the ensuing battle.

Sources:
1 Interview with Colonel (ret.) Héctor Hugo Sánchez by Antonio Bricio
2 Morgan, David (2007). Hostile Skies: My Falklands Air War.
3 Interview with David Morgan by Imperial War Museum  https://www.iwm.org.uk/collections/item/object/80032738 (reel 17-18)
4 Bolia, Robert S. The Falklands War: The Bluff Cove Disaster.

Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
